metadata.name: Highway Lead Vehicle Hard Brake
metadata.description: Euro NCAP CCRb 2026 style on a straight Town04 highway lane: the ego and lead_car (spawn #100, ~42 m ahead in the same lane) drive at test_speed_kmh; the runner holds lead_car time_gap_s seconds ahead of the ego, then lead_car brakes at brake_decel to a stop when the ego is within 20 m of spawn #134 (~219 m after the start, enough for the gap to settle at any test speed). Base of the SV5 lead brake grid (rear-end collision / TTC). Spawn points checked against Town04 map_metadata (75 → 100 → 134 same lane and yaw); verify on CARLA.

events.description: lead_car brakes hard to a stop

test_speed_kmh.description: Speed of both cars before the lead car brakes; the ego starts at it and is held to it (Euro NCAP CCRb 2026: 30–130 km/h in 10 km/h steps).

time_gap_s.description: Gap the lead car keeps ahead of the ego before braking, in seconds of travel (Euro NCAP CCRb 2026: 1.0 s).

brake_decel.description: Braking deceleration of the lead car (Euro NCAP CCRb 2026: 4 m/s² with the cars 1.0 s apart).
